summary: Evaluate analytics proposals, KPIs and model risks with executive-level tools. Explore the five-day course and review the outline.
lede: Data analytics and data science for executives help senior leaders assess analytical work and connect its findings to business decisions. The course develops skills for framing use cases, reviewing data-quality evidence and KPI links, and assessing model purpose, limitations and oversight questions without coding. Participants also practise interpreting Excel analysis and prioritising analytics proposals by value, feasibility, data readiness and risk.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level course is designed for leaders who commission, govern or use data analysis and need to connect analytical work with decisions, accountability and business priorities.
audience: Strategy and Planning Managers using KPI evidence
prerequisites: No coding or programming is required. Familiarity with business performance reports, KPIs or management decisions will help you apply the exercises; prior data science experience is not required.
